description: This file defines YAML filters for the Kubernetes kustomize project, including filter registration, YAML marshaling/unmarshaling, and specific filter implementations such as ValueReplacer, PrefixSetter, and SuffixSetter.

classes.name: YFilter
classes.description: Wraps a Filter interface for YAML serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: YFilters
classes.description: A slice of YFilter objects with a method to extract the underlying filters.

classes.name: FilterMatcher
classes.description: Defines a filter that applies a pipeline of filters to a resource node.

classes.name: ValueReplacer
classes.description: A filter that performs string or regex replacement on a resource node's value.

classes.name: PrefixSetter
classes.description: A filter that adds a prefix to a resource node's value if not already present.

classes.name: SuffixSetter
classes.description: A filter that adds a suffix to a resource node's value if not already present.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes YAML into a YFilter, selecting the appropriate filter type.

methods.name: Filters
methods.description: Returns the list of underlying Filter objects from YFilters.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Applies the filter pipeline to a resource node.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Performs string or regex replacement on the node's value.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Adds a prefix to the node's value if not already present.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Adds a suffix to the node's value if not already present.
